versions.changelog:
- Initial release of **PRD 内审 Skill** aligned with 《PRD 文档标准规范 v2.4》
- Supports automatic content reading from Feishu docs, local files, or pasted text
- Automatically detects PRD type (A/B/C), applies the corresponding checklist, and generates a structured review report
- Includes mandatory item validation, logic checks, scoring, and improvement suggestions
- Enables "二审" (re-review) mode: compares with previous review reports and highlights fixes or outstanding issues
- Triggered by common keywords related to review in both Chinese and English
